557:t_010:7.en:
$$シンジ$$
「The spear... To think it exists in this world...」

557:t_010:8.en:
$$カヲル$$
「It seems he used that thing to forcibly warp spacetime.」

557:t_010:9.en:
$$桂$$
「I don't really get it, but he was trying to carry out $$時空修復|lc$$ with that spear, the $$時空震動弾|lc$$ and $$かなめ$$'s power, is that it?」

557:t_010:10.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Then does that mean the plan just went down the drain!?」

557:t_010:11.en:
$$オルソン$$
「That's not it. The distortion of the dimensional boundary line is still continuing!」

557:t_011:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$レナード・テスタロッサ$$!」

557:t_011:1.en:
$$レナード$$
「I hadn't planned on the spear vanishing from my hands, but it has already served its purpose.」

557:t_011:2.en:
$$レナード$$
「The plan moves on to its second phase. Next, I'll release the Iota wave and have more than 80% of the people in the whole world die.」

557:t_011:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「What in the world is that for!?」

557:t_011:5.en:
$$レナード$$
「Even you should understand, shouldn't you? It's for $$時空修復|lc$$.」

557:t_011:6.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Why must people's lives be taken for that!?」

557:t_011:7.en:
$$レナード$$
「It seems you didn't know. To remake the world by one individual's will... in other words, to force a $$時空修復|lc$$ to happen...」

557:t_011:8.en:
$$レナード$$
「you have to cut down, as much as possible, the resistance put up by the power of life.」

557:t_011:11.en:
$$キラ$$
「That's... something everyone who is alive has...」

557:t_011:12.en:
$$レナード$$
「You could even call the power of life the very force that seeks to exist.」

557:t_011:13.en:
$$レナード$$
「If that refuses to let the natural order be rewritten, then no matter how great a force $$次元力$$ is, it can't control phenomena.」

557:t_011:14.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「And for that reason you would take the lives of people who know nothing!」

557:t_011:15.en:
$$レナード$$
「The $$時空修復|lc$$ during the $$多元戦争$$ and the $$時獄戦役$$ gathered the wills of nearly everyone in the world... so there was no need for anything like this.」

557:t_011:16.en:
$$レナード$$
「But there's nothing to worry about. Even the people who die that way will be able to live other lives in a world apart from this one.」

557:t_011:18.en:
$$万丈$$
「Looks like this won't end with just one more parallel world being added.」

557:t_011:19.en:
$$タケル$$
「So you're saying you'll destroy this world in order to give birth to a new one!」

557:t_011:20.en:
$$テッサ$$
「$$レナード$$... Do you honestly think we would accept something like that?」

557:t_011:21.en:
$$レナード$$
「I never intended to get your permission in the first place.」

557:t_011:22.en:
$$葵$$
「But you made a fatal mistake. The kind of mistake people who look down on others tend to make.」

557:t_011:23.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Now that we've heard about a plan to take people's lives, don't think we'll let you get away.」

557:t_011:24.en:
$$レナード$$
「Couldn't you have thought of it this way?」

557:t_011:25.en:
$$レナード$$
「That I haven't even considered the possibility of losing.」

557:t_012:0.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Look at all those giant AS!」

557:t_012:1.en:
$$勝平$$
「There are more than 30 of them!」

557:t_012:2.en:
$$レナード$$
「Worn out from one battle after another, and having dealt with the Angels, can you really win?」

557:t_012:3.en:
$$レナード$$
「At the very least, breaking through these guys will take a considerable amount of time.」

557:t_012:4.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...So this is your trump card, $$レナード$$...」

557:t_012:5.en:
$$レナード$$
「Are you going to raise the white flag, $$テレサ$$?」

557:t_012:6.en:
$$テッサ$$
「If you think I brought something like that to this place, you are sorely mistaken! ...$$相良$$!」

557:t_013:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「A suicide charge...? That's an uncharacteristic tactic.」

557:t_013:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
「We have no intention of making reckless gambles, and no intention of throwing our lives away!」

557:t_013:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「Let's do it, $$アル$$! The $$妖精の羽$$!」

557:t_014:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
「The $$妖精の羽$$, the new equipment $$ミラ$$ developed... Its effect is to temporarily nullify every $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$ within its effective range, including its own unit's...」

557:t_014:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「The opposite of the image I use for a $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$...」

557:t_014:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$ラムダ・ドライバ$$s are a sham, a swindle, a con! There's no way a supernatural phenomenon like that could happen!」

557:t_015:0.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Got 'em! Now that the $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$ is gone, that big lump can't support its own weight and it's done for!」

557:t_015:1.en:
$$マオ$$
「I never thought his old hatred of $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$s would come in handy in a place like this.」

557:t_015:2.en:
$$アル$$
「Success. The Sergeant's stubborn realism has turned the situation around.」

557:t_015:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「Can you hear me, $$千鳥$$! I came to bring you back!」

557:t_015:6.en:
$$かなめ$$
($$宗介$$...? I was sure I'd shot him dead with my own hands... What's going on...)

557:t_015:7.en:
$$宗介$$
「...I thought about using kind words, but I'm still the same old me. This is the kind of guy I am.」

557:t_015:8.en:
$$宗介$$
「I can only put things in a tactless way. So listen carefully. What I want to say is...」

557:t_015:9.en:
$$宗介$$
「I thought you were a woman with a lot more guts, that's all. Do you get it?」

557:t_015:10.en:
$$かなめ$$
(What is he on about now...)

557:t_015:11.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'll be honest, $$千鳥かなめ$$. I'm disappointed in you. I thought you were a far more impressive woman.」

557:t_015:12.en:
$$宗介$$
「No, wait... That isn't accurate either. The truth is, you've been really irritating me a lot since way back.」

557:t_015:13.en:
$$宗介$$
「You whack people on the head, you never allow calm discussion, and I got sick to my stomach wondering if you were feeding me to control me.」

557:t_015:14.en:
$$宗介$$
「You had no consideration whatsoever for pitiful me, who never knew a peaceful life.」

557:t_015:15.en:
$$宗介$$
「Looking back on it now, that wasn't fair. You're awful.」

557:t_015:16.en:
$$宗介$$
「No... that's not what matters. It just occurred to me, so I figured I'd say it while I was at it.」

557:t_015:17.en:
$$宗介$$
「...Anyway, what I'm trying to say is, are you a woman worth my throwing everything away to rescue?」

557:t_015:18.en:
$$宗介$$
「To be honest, I'm not so sure.」

557:t_015:19.en:
$$宗介$$
「At both $$ニケーロ$$ and $$ヤムスク１１$$ we were one step away, but you dragged your feet and I couldn't rescue you. Honestly... what kind of princess are you?」

557:t_015:20.en:
$$宗介$$
「Maybe you don't really have the drive? Deep down you don't care either way, do you?」

557:t_015:21.en:
$$宗介$$
「Don't tell me you'll start whimpering because I said this? Are you waiting, like any idiot girl out there, to be comforted by some idiot guy?」

557:t_015:23.en:
$$かなめ$$
(There's no way that man would talk this much. He probably means to rattle me, but I won't fall for that trick.)

557:t_015:25.en:
$$宗介$$
「What do you say, $$千鳥かなめ$$!?」

557:t_015:26.en:
$$宗介$$
「What was that about 'let's go home together'!? You're a big liar and a real bitch!」

557:t_015:27.en:
$$宗介$$
「If you say I'm wrong, then come hit me! Whack me on the head with a slipper or a paper fan or whatever!」

557:t_015:28.en:
$$かなめ$$
(What is this, seriously...? I feel awful...)
